dynamic_inputs: grug take ordered anchor sockets as coordinate pairs or one level of coordinate rows. source depth follows the first child; deeper rows are ignored. linked numeric values duplicate into both coordinates. native Any arrays retain Vector3, Vector4 and Quaternion rows through saves; standalone typed arrays of those three kinds remain outside the authored native schema.

geometry.rounding: ties to even before generating handles
geometry.handles: wrapped previous-to-next direction; adjacent distance divided by smoothness; open endpoint handles cleared; two anchors have zero handles
geometry.length_and_bounds: 32 points per segment at j/32 for j in [0,31]; omit the final subinterval and endpoint
geometry.entire_line: signed frac(sample) times measured length; loop wraps distance, open path clamps distance to [0,length]
geometry.normalized: walk measured segment lengths, then use the selected segment distance fraction
geometry.unnormalized: map distance/length through anchor count, including the closing segment on open paths
geometry.segment: floor(sample) and floor(sample)+1 use independent signed remainders; refuse undefined negative indices

state_and_cache.empty_refresh: retain previous Position output; fresh constructor starts at [0,0]
state_and_cache.singleton: Entire line returns origin; Segment samples the lone anchor
state_and_cache.memo_key: exact original distance before wrapping or clamping
state_and_cache.memo_value: sampled XY and the first caller's weight
state_and_cache.memo_scope: normalized-length sampling shares one evaluation-owned producer identity across consumers; unnormalized sampling does not cache
state_and_cache.producer_refresh: clear sample cache before the producer's initial Position query
state_and_cache.native_persistence: format 9 pm stores normalized-length policy and sorted finite unique distance snapshots; transient evaluation identities are excluded

bounds.bytes: admit output clones, path runtime workspace, replay entries and memo storage before allocation
bounds.refusal: malformed coordinates, nonfinite geometry and undefined selected zero-length segments refuse atomically
